admission_limits: Context source IDs/provenance are declarations rather than independent authentication. The runner must pin exact fixture generation and call require_task before consuming or optimizing batches.
Decision-model/reward identity cannot be independently reconstructed from an observation DTO. require_task is the explicit boundary for that check.
This guard is not an adversarial Python-code sandbox; callers with arbitrary code can forge attributes or invoke torch directly.
